en: The Section on the Training Rules (Sekhiyakaṇḍa)
At that time, the Buddha, the Blessed One, was dwelling at Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.
Now at that time, the group-of-six monks, while eating, thrust their entire hand into the mouth... [as before] ...
"The training is to be observed: 'While eating, I shall not thrust my entire hand into the mouth.
One who is eating must not thrust the entire hand into the mouth.
If, out of disrespect, one eats by putting the entire hand into the mouth, there is an offense of wrong-doing (dukkaṭa).
There is no offense if it was unintentional … [and so forth] …
"For one who is a first-time offender.
The second training rule is concluded.
